brief: A habit tracker as a garden — daily completion waters plants, streaks bloom, neglect wilts

dominant_strengths: Metaphor reads instantly: sprout/bloom/dirt states map cleanly to streak length, giving the tracker emotional stakes.
Soft sky palette with warm soil and green stems is harmonious and matches the gentle, nurturing brief tone.
Card grid is calm and well-spaced, with consistent vertical rhythm between illustration, label, streak, and CTA.
dominant_weaknesses: Plant illustrations are nearly identical across 12-day, 8-day, and 5-day streaks — visual growth differentiation is missing, undermining the core metaphor.
CTA buttons use flat saturated cyan that clashes with the muted pastel garden palette and feels generic SaaS, not garden-native.
Emoji icons (✅ 🌱 ☁️) mixed with custom SVG plants break craft consistency; typography is competent but unremarkable Inter-default.
fix_priorities: Differentiate plant growth stages dramatically — seed, sprout, bud, bloom, wilt — so the garden actually narrates streak history at a glance.
Replace cyan buttons with earth-toned or watering-can-themed CTAs that belong in the garden world.
Swap emoji for custom iconography matching the SVG illustration style for unified craft.
Introduce subtle motion cues (sway, watering droplet, bloom animation) to deliver on the 'watering' verb.
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective metaphor leads, behavioral loop is clear via daily CTAs, but visceral payoff is weak because plants barely change as streaks grow.
rationale.intent_fit: Concept aligns with the brief but execution under-delivers — the garden looks the same whether you're on day 0 or day 15, so neglect and bloom feel indistinguishable.
